models.method_note: Started with all 40 CDC PLACES crude prevalence variables, used DIABETES_CrudePrev as the dependent variable, and used the remaining variables as candidate predictors. Predictors were standardized before LASSO selection. The alpha penalty was selected by scanning a warm-started LASSO path and choosing the model with the lowest BIC. P-values are approximate post-LASSO OLS p-values from refitting ordinary least squares on the selected variables.
